minutes.headline: Committee voted unanimously to proceed with the new-build TCP concept with minor tweaks, and to send articles 1 and 2 to fall town meeting.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee reviewed the architect's new-construction layout and site plan, a comparison to the earlier renovation. Members asked for small tweaks (storage, kitchen placement, parking) but agreed to keep the layout and the same parking count rather than redesign. In the second half they voted on warrant articles for the fall special town meeting and discussed public outreach and meeting dates.

votes.motion: Hard stop at seven for the meeting
Ask architect to make minor tweaks, otherwise move forward with the overall layout and grounds plan, keeping roughly 150 parking spaces
Formally propose articles 1 and 2 for the fall special town meeting warrant and recommend article 3 language to the select board, with a dollar amount attached to article 3

budget_items.what_was_said: A member warned against adding items like a loading dock or extra square footage so the new-build cost stays comparable to the renovation program.
A member said each year of delay adds a percentage increase to the cost and estimated the total delay cost.
figures_as_heard: a hundred thousand dollars a year

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said a new design process would cost in a known range and the dollar figure should be set before the finance committee meets.
A member recalled an older estimate for moving town offices into the existing building without a big renovation.

budget_items.topic: Cost of L-shaped building versus square
budget_items.what_was_said: The architect said an L shape adds foundation and exterior skin but gives daylight; a cost estimate would need both options priced.

budget_items.topic: Building a structure able to take a second floor later
budget_items.what_was_said: The architect said sizing steel and footings now for a future second floor costs a modest amount more up front.

decisions.decision: Architect to make low-hanging tweaks (storage boosted to match prior plan, ACE kitchen moved near utilities, parking and outdoor play space) and continue developing the site rather than redesign.
Public outreach date left undecided; to be decided at the next meeting after the select board's warrant decisions, with a public forum anticipated in early November.
Keep October 6, 13, 20 and 27 as placeholder meeting dates and cancel any not needed.
Town will post committee information on its Facebook page; the select board's social media policy to be checked.

what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously to keep the new-build layout and grounds plan, with minor tweaks and roughly the same parking count.
The committee voted unanimously to propose articles 1 and 2 for the fall special town meeting and to recommend article 3 language to the select board, with a dollar amount attached.
The architect was asked to make small changes (storage, kitchen placement, parking, outdoor play space) rather than redesign the building.
The date for public outreach was left open, with a public forum anticipated in early November; four October dates were kept as placeholders.

why_it_matters: The new-build design now moves toward a fall special town meeting, where residents may be asked to vote on design funding (article 3) for the project.
The cost of the new build, the cost of delay and a future second floor were discussed, but the minutes record no settled figure, so the price residents would vote on is not yet public here.
watch_next: The select board's decisions on the warrant articles, after which the committee will set its public outreach date.
A public forum anticipated in early November, and the placeholder meeting dates of October 6, 13, 20 and 27.
